battle.name: 蒙古征服花剌子模
battle.theater: 河中、呼羅珊與阿富汗水道
battle.brief: 一二一九年春，成吉思汗以商旅被殺為由，分兵渡過錫爾河，圍困訛答剌；一二二〇年二月取布哈拉、三月下撒馬爾罕，同年冬深入呼羅珊，一二二一年再攻木鹿、掃蕩加茲尼。卡面的十字弩是蒙古攻城技術的一環，壓制牆頭弓手準確，但野戰仍靠角弓取勝。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 蒙古征服花剌子模是1219至1221年大蒙古國對花剌子模王國所作的戰役，戰場橫跨錫爾河與阿姆河之間的河中地區、呼羅珊以及今阿富汗一線。蒙古方面由成吉思汗直接統轄，部隊依十進位編為千戶、百戶、十戶，各戶自有首領，帳下設怯薛宿衛與各路探馬。作戰骨幹是能日行百里的騎兵，人人有馬，一兵常備數匹，攜帶複合角弓、短刀、長矛與札甲皮甲。攻城則依賴隨軍的漢人、契丹與回回工匠所提供的技術：配重投石機、雲梯、穴地、木製攻城架與繩索。這批技術人員多是被攻陷城市留下的匠人，被編入軍籍，成為蒙古攻城能力的來源。花剌子模方面由蘇丹阿拉烏丁·穆罕默德二世統治，國土包括撒馬爾罕、布哈拉、兀魯格齊、玉龍傑赤、木鹿、尼沙普爾、赫拉特等城。蘇丹刻意分權，每城由總督與禁軍自行防守，兵力彼此不相統屬。守城依賴厚重的土坯城牆、護城河與密集的人工運河，弓箭手、弩手與投石機編在牆頭，另有騎兵團與各地徵召的民兵。蘇丹把援軍分屯各城，結果各城孤立，無從互相接應。
countriesEn: The Mongol conquest of Khwarazm was a campaign fought by the Great Mongol Empire against the Khwarazmian state between 1219 and 1221, fought across the Transoxiana between the Syr Darya and the Amu Darya, the region of Khorasan, and the approaches to present-day Afghanistan. On the Mongol side the command rested directly with Genghis Khan; the troops were organised on a decimal basis into thousand-, hundred- and ten-man units, each with its own head, and the imperial camp carried the keshig guard and the outlying scouts. The backbone was a cavalry that could cover a hundred li a day; every rider had a horse, a man commonly had several, and each carried a composite recurved bow, a short sword, a long spear and either lamellar or leather armour. For sieges the Mongols relied on the craft of Han Chinese, Khitan and Huihui technicians who marched with the army: counterweight trebuchets, scaling ladders, saps, wooden siege frames and rope. These technicians were for the most part artisans left behind in the cities that had fallen, enrolled into the army, and they became the source of Mongol siege capability. On the Khwarazmian side the state was ruled by the shah Ala al-Din Muhammad II, and its territory included Samarqand, Bukhara, Urgench, Konye-Urgench, Merv, Nishapur and Herat. The shah deliberately divided authority: each city was to be held by its own governor and its own garrison, and the forces were not subordinate to one another. Defence relied on massive walls of unbaked brick, on moats, and on a dense network of artificial canals, with archers, crossbowmen and stone-throwers posted on the ramparts, supported by cavalry formations and by militia levied from the countryside. Because the shah quartered his relief armies among the cities, the cities stood isolated, with no way to support one another.
people: 蒙古方面的核心是成吉思汗鐵木真。一二一九年春，他以花剌子模殺死蒙古使節與商旅為口實，集合大軍西征，其子察合台、窩闊台、術赤各領一翼，幼子拖雷隨父同行。中亞方面最見功的是兩位萬戶長：速不台與傑別。他們率一支部眾越過阿姆河，繞到呼羅珊與波斯腹地，切斷花剌子模的援軍通道並追擊蘇丹，使蘇丹的逃亡路線被逐步收窄。蒙古軍中的攻城技術由漢人與契丹軍官率工匠隊操作，其中以回回匠人所造的配重投石機最為關鍵，投石機手多被編為特設的攻城部隊，隨大軍遷徙。花剌子模方面，蘇丹阿拉烏丁·穆罕默德二世是全軍的指揮中樞，但他把兵權拆散在多城，任用外族總督與禁軍互相牽制。尼沙普爾總督沙欣沙反覆請援，蘇丹只給少量援兵，令全城陷落。兀魯格齊總督安瓦爾·阿德·穆赫姆德在城破前自焚而死，訛答剌總督因吉被自己的部將殺死。木鹿方面，傳記稱托克瑪部首領阿伊巴克向蒙古軍交出城中名貴之家名單，指引破城，說法雖有誇飾，仍反映木鹿城內部人心已散。蘇丹太子哲烈亦從呼羅珊逃入波斯，後又退入興都庫什，於一二二一年率軍在印度河畔與蒙古騎兵交戰，敗後西走，至旁遮普一帶終於被殺。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Mongol side was Genghis Khan, Temujin. In the spring of 1219 he took as his warrant the killing of Mongol envoys and merchants by the Khwarazmians, mustered his army and marched west; his sons Chagatai, Ogedei and Jochi each led a wing, and his youngest son Tolui rode with him. The two men who did the most in Central Asia were the commanders Subutai and Jebe. They led a force across the Amu Darya, drove deep into Khorasan and Persia, cut the Khwarazmian relief routes and drove the shah into ever narrower ground. The siegecraft of the Mongol army was worked by Chinese and Khitan officers directing teams of technicians, of whom the most important were the Huihui artisans who built the counterweight trebuchets; the crews of these engines were formed into a specialist arm that moved with the main army. On the Khwarazmian side the shah Ala al-Din Muhammad II was the nominal commander of everything, but he broke the power of the army into many hands and used foreign governors and garrisons to counterbalance one another. The governor of Nishapur, Shakin Shah, petitioned repeatedly for aid and received only a few hundred horse, and the city was lost. The governor of Urgench, Anwar al-Din Muhammad, burned himself to death rather than be taken. The governor of Otrar, Inju, was killed by his own officers. For Merv, the Persian narrative holds that Aybak of the Toqma' tribe handed the Mongols a list of the city's notables and showed them the way in; the story is embellished, but it does record that the city had lost its nerve. The shah's son Jalal al-Din, having escaped through Khorasan into Persia and then back into the Hindu Kush, brought up a field army and fought the Mongol horse by the Indus in 1221, and after his defeat was destroyed in the Punjab while in flight.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是十字弩。弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢：在城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。蒙古軍中的弩分兩路來源，一是由漢人與契丹工匠攜帶的中式擘張弩、步弩與床弩，攻城時架在木架與城頭對壘，一發可破城樓上的守兵與旗幟；二是小型的臂力手弩，置於馬上或城堞，供射手在騎乘中作近程射擊。花剌子模守軍同樣用弩，牆上多設弩台，備有絞盤拉弦、拉力較大的弩，野戰步兵則以波斯弓與標槍為主。真正決定城牆命運的是配重投石機：蒙古軍自1211年攻金之役起便由回回匠人操作這類攻城砲，於布哈拉、撒馬爾罕、尼沙普爾、兀魯格齊一線轟擊城樓與城頭，把守軍的射擊陣位逐段拆散；花剌子模自己也備有配重投石機與弩砲，用於兀魯格齊與木鹿的守城。除攻具外，蒙古騎兵的裝備以複合反曲角弓為核心，箭鏃分骨鏃、鐵鏃與獸牙箭，另有短刀、長矛、套索與札甲、披膊，甲葉以生牛皮、鐵片與絲編綴成；馬匹數量遠超步兵，一兵常備數匹，兼作乘騎與負載，遠征時以氈帳、奶酪與乾肉隨行，就地徵用被征服城鎮的穀物、牲畜與工匠。攻城器械需木料、繩索、硝石與大量人力，故蒙古軍每攻一城即就地徵用城內工匠、鐵匠與攻城用木料，並把技術人員編入軍籍帶走。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the crossbow. The crossbow hands the rate of fire over to mechanism and pays for it with slow reloading: on a wall it is more reliable than a longbow, in the open field it is more fragile. The crossbows in Mongol service came from two directions. The first was the Chinese tensed crossbow, the foot crossbow and the bed crossbow, carried by Chinese and Khitan technicians and set up on timber frames against the enemy during a siege, a single bolt enough to break up the defenders and their banners on a tower. The second was the small hand crossbow, carried on horseback or on the parapet, for a shooter to make a short-range shot in the saddle. The Khwarazmian defenders used crossbows as well, with bolt platforms along the walls and heavier engines worked by windlass, while their foot in the field relied on Persian bows and javelins. What really decided the fate of the walls was the counterweight trebuchet. From the campaign against Jin in 1211 the Mongols had such siege engines worked by Huihui artisans, and they were used at Bukhara, Samarqand, Nishapur and Urgench to batter towers and ramparts and to break up the firing positions of the defenders piece by piece; the Khwarazmians had counterweight trebuchets and bolt-throwers of their own for the defence of Urgench and Merv. Apart from the siege equipment, the Mongol rider's kit was built around the composite recurved bow, with bone, iron and barbed arrowheads, together with a short sword, a long spear, a lasso, and lamellar or brigandine armour whose plates were laced from rawhide, iron and silk. Horses outnumbered men many times over, a man commonly having several, used both for riding and for carrying loads; on campaign the columns moved with felt tents, dried milk and dried meat, and took grain, livestock and craftsmen from the towns they took. Siege engines needed timber, rope, saltpetre and a great deal of labour, so after each city the Mongols levied its craftsmen, its smiths and its timber for the engines, and enrolled the technicians into the army to take with them.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法可以用四句話概括：分兵、迂迴、圍城、不救。1219年大軍分為數路同時開進：一路取河中諸城，一路掃呼羅珊，一路由速不台與傑別率騎兵越過阿姆河，插入波斯方向。迂迴是取勝的關鍵，速不台、傑別先以急行軍晝夜兼程抵達阿姆河，隨後轉入呼羅珊與裏海沿岸，切斷蘇丹與各城的聯繫，使任何一座城市的援軍都無法通過。圍城講究封鎖：蒙古軍抵城後先合圍四面，禁止消息出入，不急於強攻，而是先造攻城架、架設投石機、斷其樵採與水源，同時把城外的田地與運河掌握在手中。對野戰主力則實行不救的原則，被圍城市求救，其他城市與野外部隊一律不援，反而趁援軍出城之際在城外邀擊，花在馳援路上的花剌子模騎兵常在距城不遠處被合圍殲滅。攻城時先用配重投石機集中火力打擊城樓、塔樓與城門，令守軍失去居高臨下的射界，再以穴地與雲梯接近，缺口打開後由騎兵與步兵一併突入。攻城不成時，蒙古軍常改用封鎖與破壞的辦法：拆毀城郊的灌渠與水壩，令城市的農業基礎崩潰，同時把工匠與技術人員挑出編入軍籍。時序上，蒙古大軍於冬季在阿姆河冰面渡河，避開炎熱與草料不足的季節，1221年又轉向加茲尼與印度河一線，因此戰役每一步都與季節、草場和河流的可通行性綁在一起。唯一一次花剌子模在野戰中取勝的是帕爾萬之役，太子哲烈亦以大隊騎兵合擊追擊中的蒙古先鋒，擊潰追兵，但撤退時仍被蒙古軍咬住不放。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method can be put in four words: divide, turn, invest, refuse to relieve. In 1219 the army moved on several lines at once: one to take the cities of Transoxiana, one to sweep Khorasan, and one under Subutai and Jebe to cross the Amu Darya and drive into the Persian direction. The turning movement was the key: Subutai and Jebe first rode day and night to reach the Amu Darya and then swung into Khorasan and the Caspian littoral, cutting the shah off from his cities so that no relief force could reach any of them. The investment of a city was a matter of sealing it: once on the spot the army closed round it on all four sides, letting no news out, and did not hurry to assault. It raised the siege frames, set up the trebuchets, cut the defenders' firewood and water, and at the same time took hold of the fields and canals outside the walls. Against the field army they followed a principle of no relief: when an invested city called for help, no other city and no field column answered, and the Mongols waited for the relieving force to come out of the city so as to catch it outside; the Khwarazmian horse spent on that errand were often surrounded and destroyed a short march from the walls they were trying to reach. When they stormed a city they first concentrated the counterweight trebuchets on the towers, the bastions and the gates, so as to take the defenders' plunging field of fire away from them, then came forward with saps and ladders, and once a breach was opened poured in cavalry and foot together. Where the siege failed, the Mongols fell back on blockade and destruction: they broke the irrigation canals and the dams outside the towns and so ruined the agricultural basis of the cities, while picking out the craftsmen and technicians to be enrolled into the army. In time the great army crossed the Amu Darya on the ice in winter, avoiding the heat and the shortage of fodder, and in 1221 turned towards Ghazni and the Indus; every step of the campaign was therefore bound up with the season, the pasture and the passages of the rivers. The one occasion on which the Khwarazmians won a field battle was the battle of Parwan, where the prince Jalal al-Din massed his cavalry against a Mongol vanguard in pursuit and destroyed it, though even in retreat he could not shake the Mongols off.
data: 關於蒙古軍的兵力，說法分歧，波斯史家與《集史》所記多在十萬至二十萬之間，現代研究一般認為西征大軍連同各路偏師在十萬上下，其中負責攻布哈拉、撒馬爾罕的主力當在數萬騎。第一支投入作戰的隊伍是一二一九年春自咸海方向渡過錫爾河者，兵數以數萬計。攻城各役，蒙古方面的工程部隊往往數千人，攻城結束後即被整編隨軍前進。花剌子模方面的總兵力在波斯史料中常被寫成數十萬，但多數分散在二三十座城市與各路總督手中，蘇丹本人在前線可集中者遠少於此數。可確認的戰役時序是：1219年春至秋圍困訛答剌，同年冬進至布哈拉，1220年二月取布哈拉、三月取撒馬爾罕，同年三月取尼沙普爾、四月進向木鹿，夏秋兵鋒抵達呼羅珊與波斯，1220年九月帕爾萬之役，1221年二月取木鹿，同年攻加茲尼與巴格達方向，1221年十一月印度河之戰。距離上，訛答剌至布哈拉約六百公里，布哈拉至撒馬爾罕約二百五十公里，木鹿至尼沙普爾約五百公里，最遠的追擊路線由阿姆河一直推到印度河畔，縱貫數千里。守城方面的損失，記載最一致的是訛答剌、尼沙普爾、兀魯格齊等城的守軍全滅或潰散，蒙古騎兵在野戰中屢記繳獲大量俘虜與輜重。全役歷時約兩年，被毀的城市達數十座，灌溉渠系被系統性破壞；蒙古軍本身最大的損失是馬匹與冬季缺糧造成的減員，而非某一場會戰的殲滅。
dataEn: The figures for the Mongol army are given inconsistently. The Persian chroniclers and the Jami al-Tawarikh put the total between a hundred thousand and two hundred thousand, while modern work generally treats the invading army with its attached columns as something on the order of a hundred thousand, of which the force assigned to Bukhara and Samarqand was a number of tens of thousands of riders. The first body actually committed was the column that crossed the Syr Darya in the spring of 1219 from the direction of the Aral Sea, and its numbers run into the tens of thousands. In the sieges the Mongol engineering detachment was commonly several thousand strong, and after each city it was reformed and marched on with the army. The total strength of the Khwarazmians is written in the Persian sources as several hundred thousand, but most of it was dispersed among twenty or thirty cities and among the commands of their governors, and the shah could concentrate far less than that on any one line. The sequence that can be fixed is as follows: the investment of Otrar through the spring and autumn of 1219 and the advance to Bukhara in the winter of that year; Bukhara taken in February 1220 and Samarqand in March; Nishapur taken in March and the advance on Merv in April; the spearhead reaching Khorasan and Persia in the summer and autumn; the battle of Parwan in September 1220; Merv taken in February 1221; the same year the move on Ghazni and towards Baghdad; and the battle of the Indus in November 1221. In distance, Otrar lies about six hundred kilometres from Bukhara, Bukhara about two hundred and fifty from Samarqand, and Merv about five hundred from Nishapur, while the furthest line of pursuit ran from the Amu Darya to the banks of the Indus, a stretch of thousands of kilometres. As to the losses of the defending side, the most consistent testimony is that the garrisons of Otrar, Nishapur, Urgench and their like were annihilated or scattered, and that Mongol columns repeatedly recorded large captures of prisoners and booty in the field. The campaign as a whole lasted about two years, the number of towns destroyed runs into the dozens, and the irrigation works were systematically broken up; the Mongols' own heaviest loss was the wastage of horses and the shortage of fodder in winter rather than annihilation in any single pitched battle.
cause: 直接導火線是商旅與使節的糾紛。蒙古與花剌子模在1218年之前已有往來，蒙古商隊攜帶貨物西行，進入花剌子模境內後被課以重稅，部分商旅與貨物在訛答剌一帶被扣押殺害，被扣者中還有被當作使節看待的蒙古人。蘇丹阿拉烏丁收到報告後的處置，是把責任推給屬下、殺死本地官員以平息爭端，卻不追究商隊的賠償；於是蒙古再派使團交涉，據《集史》記載這批使者仍被處決，使團的首腦被斬。成吉思汗由此判定談判無用，下令全面西征。更深一層的原因是戰略上的：他已完成草原的統一，滅西夏在即，蒙古的畜牧業經濟需要穩定的商路與冬季牧場，而花剌子模扼守中亞商道的咽喉，又站在西夏的背後，此前已允許西夏使者借道攻擊蒙古，雙方的對立因此不可避免。傳統史家另指出一層私人因素：成吉思汗的孛兒帖早年為蔑兒乞部所掠，蔑兒乞首領泰吉奇汗其後據有錫爾河下游並投靠花剌子模，因此西征亦有追擊舊敵的性質。最後是蘇丹的戰略誤判：他以為蒙古只是一支來搶劫的邊騎，選擇分兵固守各城、拒絕集中應戰，又把情報系統與援軍調度分散，這使花剌子模在疆域廣大、兵力不少的情況下逐城陷落。
causeEn: The immediate spark was a quarrel over merchants and envoys. There had been contact between the Mongols and Khwarazm before 1218: Mongol caravans had travelled west with their goods and, once inside Khwarazmian territory, had been loaded with heavy duties, and parts of the caravans and their goods were detained and killed around Otrar, among them Mongols who were treated as envoys. The shah Ala al-Din's response to the report was to shift the blame onto his subordinates and put local officials to death to still the affair, while the compensation for the caravans was never pursued; the Mongols thereupon sent another embassy, and the Jami al-Tawarikh records that its members were executed and that the head of the mission was beheaded. Genghis Khan concluded from this that negotiation was useless and ordered the general advance to the west. One level deeper lies a strategic cause: he had completed the unification of the steppe, the conquest of the Western Xia was close at hand, and the pastoral economy of the Mongols required secure trade routes and winter pasture, while Khwarazm stood on the throat of the Central Asian caravan roads and behind the Xia, having already given the Xia envoys leave to cross its territory and attack the Mongols from the rear. The two were therefore bound to come into collision. Traditional historians point to a further, personal element: Borte, Genghis Khan's wife, had been carried off in her youth by the Merkits, whose leader Tajich Beg later held the lower Syr Darya and sought the protection of Khwarazm, so that the western campaign had in part the character of a pursuit of an old enemy. In the end there was the shah's misreading of the situation: he took the Mongols for a border horseman band come to plunder, chose to hold each city separately with divided troops rather than concentrate for a set-piece battle, and scattered his intelligence system and his system of relief, which is why Khwarazm, with wide territories and no small army, lost its cities one after another.
impact: 這場戰役的直接後果，是花剌子模王國作為獨立政權在兩年內解體，蒙古得以把河中、呼羅珊與今阿富汗大部收入版圖，隨後以此為基地向高加索與波斯縱深推進，並在1223年回師攻金。更深遠的影響在交通與技術兩方面。技術上，配重投石機與弩類攻城器械隨蒙古軍進入中亞與西亞，歐洲人在十三世紀初已經在匈牙利與波蘭的戰役中接觸到這類器械，其技術來源之一，正是蒙古軍中的漢人與回回工匠；蒙古的工程部隊後來成為常設的攻城特種兵。花剌子模的灌溉體系與城市網絡在戰役中被系統性破壞，運渠與水壩被改道、田地被拋荒，數十座城市被夷平，柯瓦茲姆綠洲此後數百年一直是低開發的鹽鹼地，直到近代才重新整治，這是中亞史上持續時間最長的經濟倒退之一。對歐洲的另一重影響是知識上的：1222年由匈牙利返回的多明我會修士寫成的書信，描述了東方大王的土地與軍隊，在歐洲廣為流傳；與此同時通往蒙古的商路被打開，威尼斯與熱那亞的商人自1240年代起可以沿驛站路綫橫跨歐亞。對南亞而言，1221年蒙古軍在印度河畔停止深入，使德里蘇丹國得以存續，也開啟了此後蒙古與印度保持互市、再於1290年代兵戎相見的長線關係。人口與技術的流動同樣巨大：大批花剌子模的匠人、醫者與官吏被編入蒙古軍籍，隨軍西遷，其技術與知識隨之擴散至帝國各部。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the campaign was that the Khwarazmian state dissolved as an independent polity within two years. The Mongols took Transoxiana, Khorasan and the greater part of present-day Afghanistan into their orbit, used it as a base for the deeper advance into the Caucasus and Persia, and turned back to the war against Jin in 1223. The deeper effects lie in two fields, transport and technique. Technologically, the counterweight trebuchet and the crossbow family of siege weapons travelled with the Mongol army into Central and Western Asia, and Europeans met such machines in the battles in Hungary and Poland in the early thirteenth century; one of their sources was precisely the Chinese and Huihui technicians serving in the Mongol army, and the Mongol engineering corps later became a standing specialist arm for sieges. The irrigation system and the urban network of Khwarazm were systematically destroyed in the campaign, canals and dams were diverted, fields were abandoned, dozens of towns were razed, and the Khorezm oasis remained a poorly developed saline waste for the following centuries, until it was reclaimed in modern times; this is among the longest economic reversals in the history of Central Asia. The other effect on Europe was one of knowledge: the letter written in 1222 by a Dominican friar returning from Hungary described the lands and the armies of the great king of the east and circulated widely in Europe; at the same time the road to the Mongols was opened, and from the 1240s merchants of Venice and Genoa could cross Eurasia along the lines of the relay stations. For South Asia, the Mongol halt by the Indus in 1221 let the Delhi Sultanate survive, and it opened the long relationship in which the Mongols and India first kept their exchanges and then came to arms again in the 1290s. The movement of people and skills was enormous in the same way: great numbers of Khwarazmian artisans, physicians and officials were enrolled into the Mongol military registers and carried west with the armies, and their craft and learning spread with them to every part of the empire.
result: 結果是花剌子模的軍事與政治體系被徹底摧毀。蘇丹阿拉烏丁在布哈拉與撒馬爾罕陷落後西逃，經呼羅珊退入波斯境內，一二二〇年死於裏海邊緣，至死未能重新集結軍隊。太子哲烈亦在帕爾萬打敗過蒙古先鋒，卻在印度河畔被成吉思汗的主力擊敗，率殘部退入旁遮普，隨後在逃亡中被追兵毀滅，蘇丹室的抵抗至此完全中斷。訛答剌、布哈拉、撒馬爾罕、尼沙普爾、兀魯格齊、木鹿、赫拉特、加茲尼等城相繼陷落，尼沙普爾在三天之內被配重投石機與穴地攻城破壞，兀魯格齊在圍城約一個月後被砲火擊中城樓而崩，木鹿在蒙古軍合圍數月後幾乎未經抵抗即開城。各城的守軍或潰散或全滅，城市被拆毀、灌渠被改，數十座城邑從地圖上消失。蒙古方面的收穫是完整的河中與呼羅珊，以及大批被徵用的工匠與技術人員；代價則是遠征的消耗與冬季的減員。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰役再次證明決定勝負的不是某一種弓弩：十字弩在城頭可靠，卻守不住被封鎖在城內的城市；真正改變局面的是配重投石機、遠距打擊與騎兵迂迴的結合，以及把攻城技術制度化的軍隊。往後蒙古在亞洲與歐洲的攻城戰，仍沿用同一套組合。
resultEn: The result was the complete destruction of the Khwarazmian military and political system. After the fall of Bukhara and Samarqand the shah Ala al-Din fled west, withdrew through Khorasan into Persian territory, and died in 1220 on the edge of the Caspian without ever rallying an army again. The prince Jalal al-Din had defeated a Mongol vanguard at Parwan, but was beaten by Genghis Khan's main force by the Indus, and with the remnants of his army withdrew into the Punjab, where he was destroyed while in flight; the resistance of the shah's house was then completely broken. Otrar, Bukhara, Samarqand, Nishapur, Urgench, Merv, Herat, Ghazni and other cities fell in turn: Nishapur was broken in three days by trebuchet fire and sapping, Urgench collapsed after about a month of investment when a shot struck a tower, and Merv opened its gates almost without resistance after months of investment by the Mongol army. The garrisons were either scattered or annihilated, the cities were dismantled, the canals were diverted, and dozens of towns disappeared from the map. What the Mongols gained was the whole of Transoxiana and Khorasan together with a large number of levied craftsmen and technicians; what they paid was the wastage of the campaign and the thinning of the army in winter. From the point of view of the history of weapons, the campaign once again showed that the outcome was not decided by any one bow or crossbow: the crossbow was reliable on a wall, yet it could not hold a city sealed inside it; what changed the situation was the combination of counterweight trebuchets, stand-off fire and cavalry turning movements, together with an army that had institutionalised siegecraft. The Mongols went on to use the same combination in their sieges across Asia and Europe.
